findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: allai_brands, basic_verification, news_events, api_status, email_validate, consumer_complaints, federal_register, doi_lookup, url_inspect · Private data: get_receipt, cyber_threats, trade_rules, email_validate, web_check, clinical_trials, consumer_complaints, federal_register, nih_grants, url_inspect · Public sink: email_validate, consumer_complaints · Destructive: id_validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: allai_brands, basic_verification, news_events, api_status, email_validate, consumer_complaints, federal_register, doi_lookup, url_inspect · Private data: get_receipt, cyber_threats, trade_rules, email_validate, web_check, clinical_trials, consumer_complaints, federal_register, nih_grants, url_inspect · Public sink: email_validate, consumer_complaints · Destructive: id_validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
